summary: Comprehensive testing of ZK Shield feature (Veil clone via Bifrost v1 proxy). All 12 backend proxy tests pass. Frontend ZK Shield tab, swap-card tab, iframe rendering, and full Veil wallet creation flow (password modal -> recovery key starting with 'veilsk' -> Open Veil -> dashboard with Private balance / Veil Wallet address / Deposit/Trade/Send/Receive/Withdraw) all work end-to-end. Sidebar nav (Shield/Trade/Send/Receive/Withdraw/VeilSwap/Earn/Activity/Keys) switches views cleanly. No 'Veil is not fully connected' banner persists.
critical_code_review_comments: bifrost.py line ~169: regex /(?<![A-Za-z0-9_/.])/_next/ relies on negative lookbehind which may still match inside already-prefixed /api/bifrost/v1/app/_next/ in rare edge cases (e.g., inside JSON strings). Verified empirically to work for current app but worth a unit test.
ShieldPage.jsx hard-codes allow='publickey-credentials-get *' — modern Chromium warns 'web-share' feature is unrecognized (console warning only, non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bifrost.py -o addopts=''`. The pytest.ini contains xdist defaults that break single-process run; override addopts if needed. Veil 'Create a Veil wallet' trigger is the <button> that wraps the card text (not a text node); click via `button:has-text('Create a Veil wallet')` or evaluate_handle. Recovery key regex: /veilsk\S+/.
